description: The line plot illustrates the similarity scores across different layers for four distinct configurations—en&en, en&el, en&es, and en&bn—each represented by a colored line. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 2 to 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2, indicating the layer number within a model. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," ranges from 0.05 to 0.45, with grid lines at intervals of 0.05, representing the similarity metric. The red line, corresponding to en&en, starts at a similarity of approximately 0.10 at layer 2, rises to a peak of about 0.33 at layer 4, and then generally trends downward to around 0.28 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to approximately 0.45 at layer 22. The blue line (en&es) begins at about 0.09, peaks at 0.32 at layer 4, and then declines to roughly 0.27 at layer 20, rising to 0.42 at layer 22. The green line (en&el) starts at 0.08, peaks at 0.22 at layer 4, and then gradually increases to about 0.26 at layer 20, ending at 0.41 at layer 22. The pink line (en&bn) begins at 0.07, peaks at 0.21 at layer 4, and then fluctuates slightly before rising to approximately 0.26 at layer 20 and reaching 0.41 at layer 22. All four lines show a general increase in similarity from layer 2 to layer 20, followed by a sharp increase in similarity from layer 20 to layer 22.
